svg.title: The states of a run, and of a finding in a register
svg.desc: A run starts RUNNING. A question or a pause parks it, and an answer or resume continues it; when its process ends it is INTERRUPTED and resume continues it. It ends COMPLETED, COMPLETED_WITH_ERRORS when a checked command failed, FAILED when a step failed, or CANCELLED; an ended run gets its manifest and its end entry in the ledger. A finding is OPEN when a report states it. Somebody accepts it as a risk with a note and a review date, or dismisses it with a note. An accepted risk whose review date passed awaits verification. A finding is RESOLVED when it is no longer reported, when a decided one was absent from three reports, or when a fix holds. It goes back to OPEN when it is reported again, reported above the severity a decision was made on, or reopened by hand.
